summary: Example group_vars/ios.yml with network_cli, cisco.ios.ios, vaulted passwords, become enable and proxy command; the paramiko proxy variable is deprecated for ansible_libssh_proxy_command.
questions: What group_vars do I need for Cisco IOS?
How do I set a jump host for Cisco IOS devices?

answer_card.title: Cisco IOS group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: cisco.ios.ios
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
ansible_become_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
`ansible_paramiko_proxy_command` is deprecated; use `ansible_libssh_proxy_command` with libssh. Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy for direct access.
